text:
Alice: FYI, kicking off cloud account + project for new region 'orion-eu2'. Need VPC/CIDR guardrails, GPU quota requests, and a checklist for private storage access. Can netops/infra pair on this?

Ben: Copy. How many GPU nodes and what shapes are we planning for the initial pool? That will affect subnets + NAT sizing.

Alice: Start with ~6 nodes: mix of 4xA100-40G and 2xA10. Expect burst to ~12 in next quarter. Primary workload is low-latency inference, persistent PVCs to object storage via private gateway.

Carla: Ok — for CIDR I recommend we avoid anything overlapping with corp-shared (10.8.0.0/16) and the global-services VPC (10.16.0.0/20). Proposal: orion-eu2 project VPC = 10.32.0.0/20, worker subnets 10.32.0.0/22 (x3 AZs), mgmt/control 10.32.8.0/24, shared-services peering 10.32.9.0/24. This keeps room for future /18 expansion.

Dmitri: Note org policy requires tags: team:redwood-inference, env:prod, region:orion-eu2. Also need KMS key ARN for disk encryption and a service account with roles: compute.admin (scoped), iam.serviceAccountUser, storage.objectAdmin (restricted to project bucket).

Emma: Re: NAT sizing — GPU nodes will do larger image pulls initially. Suggest NAT pool with 50 ephemeral ports per node as baseline (we can monitor and increase). Also plan for at least 2 static egress IPs for allowlisting customer firewalls.

Ben: I'll open the GPU quota ticket with cloud support now. Which project id to use and expected baseline qps?

Alice: Project id = rwinf-orion-prod. Expected baseline: 6 GPUs initially (4 A100 + 2 A10), request quota bump for 20 A100-equivalent to cover bursts. Include justification: inference fleet + canary experiments.

Carla: Terraform snippet for the VPC module (for reference):
```
module "orion_vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.company/repo/terraform-modules//vpc"
  project = "rwinf-orion-prod"
  region  = "orion-eu2"
  cidr    = "10.32.0.0/20"
  subnets = {
    workers = ["10.32.0.0/22","10.32.4.0/22","10.32.8.0/22"]
    control = "10.32.16.0/24"
  }
  tags = { team = "redwood-inference" env = "prod" }
}
```

Dmitri: One gotcha — org policy enforces 'restrictPrivateServiceAccess' for private GCS access. We need to create a private service connection and service perimeter exception for the storage bucket used by inference. I'll draft the Terraform for the private-service-connect resource.

Emma: Cost note: cross-region egress to our main metrics/ingest region will be ~0.09 USD/GB. If we put model artifact fetches to a local mirror in orion-eu2 (regional bucket), we save ~0.06 USD/GB on bulk pulls. Recommend staging mirror for large model downloads.

Ben: Ticket opened: https://cloudprovider.support/t/12345 (A100 quota increase + project validation). Please add any links and the project billing account.

InfraBot: [automated] Support ticket 12345 created by Ben for project rwinf-orion-prod. ETA for quota response: 48-72 hours.

Alice: Action items: 1) Ben to add billing account + requested numbers to ticket. 2) Carla to provision Terraform skeleton (PR to infra-modules). 3) Dmitri to draft private-service-connect and KMS binding. 4) Emma to estimate NAT & static IP cost and mirror storage pricing. 5) I'll schedule a 30m handoff once PRs are up.

Carla: I'll spin up the skeleton branch today and tag you all in the PR. Using the new standard naming: vpc-orion-eu2-prod.

Dmitri: Also flagging GPU vendor pre-approval: long lead times for A100 in orion-eu2 — if support pushes back, we should accept a temporary A10-heavy pool and plan live migration later.

Emma: +1 on temporary A10 plan. I'll mock cost delta and add it to the handoff doc.

Ben: Added billing account & usage justification to ticket. Updated the ticket with expected start date '2026-04-01'.

Alice: Thanks all. If anyone sees IP overlap with existing projects, shout here. Otherwise aim to have infra PR + ticket resolved by EOD Friday. :thumbsup: 

Carla: :eyes: will post PR link when ready.

InfraBot: [automated] Reminder: quota ticket 12345 will be auto-closed if no response in 14 days.

Dmitri: Quick checklist item for the handoff meeting — include runbook sections: bootstrap, node image bake, GPU driver install verification, kernel module checks, monitoring checkpoints (node-exporter + GPU metrics), and rollback plan for quick deprovisioning.

Alice: Perfect — that'll be the meeting agenda. Scheduling 10:00 UTC Friday.

Carla: PR: https://git.company/org/infra/merge/9877 (vpc skeleton + initial variables). Please review.

Ben: Review done, left two minor comments re: tags.

Emma: Cost spreadsheet link: https://docs.company/costs/orion-eu2. Added NAT & mirror estimates.

Alice: Closing check-in for now. We'll reconvene after quota confirmed. Thanks everyone. :wave:
